name: Shilchar Technologies Ltd
title: Shilchar Technologies Ltd - 531201 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 dispatches ~6,000 MVA of 7,500 MVA capacity (79% utilisation on dispatches), Q4 margin hit by ~INR35-40 cr stranded Middle East exports and oil up ~100%; FY27 guide INR800-850 cr with price revisions unconfirmed.

utilisation.quote: So 79% or almost 6000 MVA is the dispatches we have done in '26.

capex.peers_comment: Management said everyone is expanding right now but demand is enough to absorb it.
capex.quote: it's not, I mean, everyone is expanding right now. But at the same time, if you look at the numbers and if you look at the, you know, demand being generated

triggers.label: Oil price up ~100% since February
triggers.quote: oil prices have become almost double than what we used to buy in month of February

triggers.label: Gavasad-3 adds 6,500 MVA by April 2027
triggers.quote: will add 6,500 MVA and take our total installed capacity to 14,000 MVA, remains on track for commissioning in April '27

triggers.label: FY27 revenue target cut to INR800 cr
triggers.quote: I remember in last concall, you people were speaking about INR850 crores to INR900 crores for FY'27, right? And now we are speaking about INR800 crores.

guidance.quote: it will be INR800 crores to INR850 crores. Just conservatively, I am saying INR800.
Yes, we'll do our best to maintain the same margin or even increase the margin.
remains on track for commissioning in April '27

prior_guidance_check.quote: I remember in last concall, you people were speaking about INR850 crores to INR900 crores for FY'27, right?

red_flags.label: Inventory / WIP build with stranded export dispatches
red_flags.quote: we had to stop the production. I mean, we did not convert it into the finished goods

red_flags.label: Price pass-through unconfirmed on fixed-price orders
red_flags.quote: whatever orders are there at the fixed price, we are demanding price rise.

red_flags.label: Management refused April actuals
red_flags.quote: No, unfortunately, I won't be able to give you the number.

evasions.quote: No, unfortunately, I won't be able to give you the number.
I won't be able to, you know, give you the exact figures, but it will be a normal quarter.
we are not at liberty to share that but it is higher than 79%.
